question.prompt: No kept scenario currently proves that activating a title in the `Recently published` section opens that same book's detail page, because the only matching journey was deferred by budget. How should this unexercised promise be handled?

options.label: Add deferred route
options.detail: Raise or reallocate the pair budget so the recent-book title-link journey and its test can be added.

options.label: Replace another route
options.detail: Swap out one kept branch scenario if recent-book navigation is more important than one current route.

options.label: Keep uncovered
options.detail: Leave this promise as an acknowledged gap until a later assurance pass.

content.risk_rationale: Leaving ac-53 unexercised means the sampled recent-book navigation remains unproven, even though the source promises each displayed title links to that book's detail page.
